title: Welcome to Voicebar
text: Welcome to Voicebar. It's a keyboard you talk to: a slim bar at the bottom of your screen, right where your thumb is.

title: Tap Voice and talk
text: Tap Voice and just start talking. Your words land in the text box as you speak.

title: Pause, and it tidies up
text: Pause for a moment, and what you said gets cleaned up: punctuation, capitals, and the ums and likes taken out.

title: Tap or swipe to finish
text: Tap the pill when you're done. Or swipe it right to finish and send, and left to throw it away.

title: Need to type?
text: Need to type instead? ABC switches to Gboard, and the Voicebar button on Gboard brings you right back.

title: Move the cursor
text: Cursor opens a trackpad for moving around, selecting, copying and pasting.

title: Say “voice bar”
text: While you talk, say voice bar, then send, done, or cancel, and it happens hands off.

title: Hands-free
text: Say voice bar, hands free, and you can run your whole phone by voice: tap, scroll, and open apps without touching the screen.

title: You're all set
text: That's it. You can watch this again, and find more tips, under How to use it in Voicebar's settings. Happy talking.
